setting: grandmother Fumi's sunny wooden veranda and garden in mild autumn; comfortable home clothes

sentences.english: On a summer afternoon, we sat on the porch of grandmother's house and talked about the long flow of time.
sentences.japanese: 夏の午後、おばあちゃんの家の縁側に座って、長い時間の流れについて話をしました。

sentences.english: “I have lived in this house for sixty years,” grandmother said quietly.
sentences.japanese: 「わたしは60年、この家に住んでいるんだよ」とおばあちゃんが静かに言いました。

sentences.english: She pointed at the big cherry tree in the garden.
sentences.japanese: おばあちゃんは庭の大きな桜の木を指さしました。

sentences.english: “This tree has been there for thirty years,” she told us.
sentences.japanese: 「この木は、もう30年ここにあるの」と教えてくれました。

sentences.english: I talked about myself a little.
sentences.japanese: わたしも自分のことを少し話しました。

sentences.english: “I have lived in this town since I was born.
sentences.japanese: 「わたしはこの町で生まれてからずっと住んでるんだ。

sentences.english: Tom has been my best friend since this spring.”
sentences.japanese: トムは今年の春から、わたしの親友なんだよ」

sentences.english: My sister has played the piano since she was small.
sentences.japanese: 妹は小さい頃からずっとピアノを弾いています。

sentences.english: My brother has played baseball for three years, and now he is an important member of his team.
sentences.japanese: 兄は3年間野球を続けていて、今ではチームの大事な一員になっています。
